menu.title: Temporary Title
save_menu.press_enter_new: Press Enter to Start New Game
save_menu.press_enter_load: Press Enter to Resume Current Save
dialogue.intro_1: In your dreams an image appears of your family farm.
dialogue.intro_2: A familiar voice calls your name.
dialogue.intro_4: The memories of the past day flood your mind and you realize you have been sleeping in.
dialogue.intro_5: Your eyes spring open and you get out of bed.
dialogue.intro_wake: You suddenly wake up and get out of bed.
dialogue.hardcore_death_reset: [Hardcore Mode: Death has reset your progress.]
dialogue.hardcore_death_reset_2: You jolt awake in bed, drenched in sweat. For a moment, the nightmare feels disturbingly real.
dialogue.look_around_upstairs: What do you want to do?
dialogue.bed_chest_1: You approach your chest at the foot of the bed.
dialogue.bed_chest_2: You open it and see your clothes neatly placed.
dialogue.bed_chest_3: You take out a white linen shirt, dark brown trousers, belt and stockings.
dialogue.bed_chest_4: You dress yourself and reach back into your chest.
dialogue.bed_chest_5: You take out your bag and fasten it with your belt.
dialogue.sleep_1: You get in bed and fall asleep.
dialogue.sleep_2: Your dream gets interrupted by a strange sensation.
dialogue.bed_options: What do you want to do?
dialogue.rest_bed: You undress and lie down in bed.
dialogue.restore_bed: [Your health is restored as you sleep]
dialogue.save_game: Are you sure? Saving will overwrite the current save.
dialogue.save_game_2: Would you like to save and wake up in bed?
dialogue.save_game_no: [You did NOT save - returning to previous options]
dialogue.no_inventory: 'I should get dressed before I mess with things.'
dialogue.tome_read_1: You open it up and notice many of the pages are missing.
dialogue.tome_read_2: There is a loose page with a passage labeled 'Fire Protection Incantation'.
dialogue.tome_unlock_incant: You read the incantation and its knowledge leaves an imprint in your mind.
dialogue.tome_close: You close the book and step away.
dialogue.right_bookshelf: You search through the bookshelf looking for the combat treatise.
dialogue.right_bookshelf_empty: You already took the books from this shelf.
dialogue.treatise_choice: You search through the bookshelf and find the combat treatise.
dialogue.treatise_leave: You step away from the bookshelf.
dialogue.treatise_read: You open up the combat treatise and reminisce about your younger years and mandatory combat practice.
dialogue.treatise_read_2: After you are satisfied with your review, you put the book in your bag.
dialogue.forbidden covered: Looking back up at the shelf, you notice a partially hidden book wrapped in cloth.
dialogue.forbidden covered 2: You take the book and slowly unwrap it.
dialogue.forbidden_react: The book, made of some unkown dark material, is titled 'Forbidden Knowledge'.
dialogue.option.forbidden_dont_read: Take the book but don't read it.
dialogue.forbidden_open: You open the book and read the foreword.
dialogue.forbidden_read_1: In red letters it is written: He who readeth this book shall die.
dialogue.look_around_downstairs: What do you want to do?
dialogue.option.boots_by_door: Take your boots from by the door
dialogue.option.inspect_downstairs_chest: Inspect the chest by the door
dialogue.inspect_downstairs_chest: Your family stores hunting equipment in this chest.
dialogue.open_downstairs_chest: You open the chest and find your hunting sword.
dialogue.take_hunt_sword_2: 'I haven't used a sword in a while. I might be rusty.'
dialogue.leave_hunt_sword: I am not going hunting today.
dialogue.downstairs_chest_empty: You already took your hunting sword.
dialogue.check_by_door: You walk up to the door and look around.
dialogue.boots_by_door: You see your favorite pair of boots.
dialogue.take_boots: You take off your slippers and put your boots on.
dialogue.check_window: You approach the window and look outside
dialogue.window_react: 'The sky looks a bit grey tonight.'
dialogue.trapdoor: You open the trapdoor and look down...
dialogue.trapdoor_choice: Do you want to go down?
dialogue.option.trapdoor_step_away: Close the trapdoor and walk away
dialogue.trapdoor_walk_away: You close the trapdoor and turn around.
dialogue.trapdoor_fail_1: You start anxiously climbing down the ladder into the dark basement.
dialogue.trapdoor_fail_2: ... But upon reaching the ground you feel intense pain as a bright light surrounds you.
dialogue.trapdoor_pass_1: You recite the protection incantation and feel a gentle warmth surround you.
dialogue.trapdoor_pass_2: You confidently climb down to the basement, with the incantation illuminating your surroundings.
dialogue.leave_door: You open the door and step outside.
dialogue.go_outside: Stepping outside, you hear screaming and suddenly turn to your left.
dialogue.door_encounter: As the fourth invader falls, you hastily check your surroundings.
dialogue.door_boss_2: He is adorned with blackened armor, a horned helmet and a massive axe.
dialogue.door_boss_3: I am Captain Hravna. Tell me your name, boy.
dialogue.door_boss_4: 'I am Nicholas, and this is my farm.'
dialogue.door_boss_5: Unfortunate. Tonight you will be buried here.
dialogue.door_boss_6: Stepping away from his body you rush to find your family.
dialogue.door_death_1: You are suddenly impaled by a spear in your chest.
dialogue.door_death_2: You feel a sharp pain. You were shot by an arrow in your chest.
dialogue.door_death_3: You fall over suddenly as your leg is severed.
dialogue.door_death_4: You let out a scream as a sharp pain fills your mind.
dialogue.collapse_floor: You collapse on the floor and your vision fades.
dialogue.collapse_floor_book: You feel an intense pain and collapse to the floor.
dialogue.table: You check your table for anything useful.
dialogue.table_2: Among the things on the table, you find a warm loaf of bread.
dialogue.table_empty: There is nothing useful left on the table.
dialogue.inspect_table: What do you want to do?
dialogue.basement_1: You have safely descended to the basement.
dialogue.basement_2: You have safely returned to the basement.
dialogue.look_around_basement: What do you want to do?
dialogue.inspect_tools: You inspect the tools and notice a hammer and chisel.
dialogue.tools_choice: What do you want to do?
dialogue.take_tools: You pick up the hammer and chisel and put them in your bags.
dialogue.take_nothing: You step away from the tools.
dialogue.climb_to_main_floor: You climb up the ladder back to the main floor of your house.
dialogue.walls_choice: Which wall do you want to inspect?
dialogue.inspect_walls: You move to the center of the room and analyze each wall.
dialogue.inspect_right_wall: You inspect the right wall and notice several of the bricks are loose.
dialogue.inspect_bottom_wall: You inspect the bottom wall and notice several of the bricks are loose.
dialogue.right_wall_loose: Looking closer, you notice similar loose bricks along the bottom wall.
dialogue.bottom_wall_loose: Looking closer, you notice similar loose bricks along the right wall.
dialogue.wall_need_tools: You try to remove one of the bricks, but it's stuck. You'll need some tools.
dialogue.wall_use_tools: Using the tools, you slowly remove the loose bricks from both walls.
dialogue.basement_door_revealed: Behind the bricks in the right wall, an old hidden door is revealed.
dialogue.basement_door_locked: The door is locked tight, but a keyhole is visible.
dialogue.basement_door_unlock: You place the key into the door and hear it unlock.
dialogue.basement_key_found: Behind the bricks in the bottom wall, you find an old key.
dialogue.basement_door_choice: Will you enter the hidden passage?
dialogue.basement_door_inspect: You carefully inspect the old door.
dialogue.option.listen_door: Listen to movement behind the door
dialogue.listen_door: You carefully place your ear to the door and listen for movement.
dialogue.listen_door_2: Faint vibrations can be felt. They sound like... footsteps?
dialogue.inspect_crates: You walk up to the stacked crates.
dialogue.crates_choice: Do you want to check the crates?
dialogue.enter_tunnel_choice: Do you want to enter the tunnel?
dialogue.tunnel_1_intro: You look around at the walls illuminated by your spell.
dialogue.tunnel_1_cont_b: You step past the corpse of the invader and continue down the tunnel.
dialogue.tunnel_1_cont: As you make your way down the caves you hear sudden footsteps approach you.
dialogue.tunnel_1_encounter: You sidestep and barely avoid a sword to your face.
dialogue.tunnel_1_reaction_1: You step away from the body and nervously check your injuries...
dialogue.tunnel_1_reaction_2: Covered in blood, but determined, you delve further into the widening tunnel.
dialogue.tunnel_1_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.tunnel_1_explore_1: You look through the cave for hidden items.
dialogue.tunnel_1_explore_2: You are satisfied that you found everything that was hidden.
dialogue.tunnel_1_enemies_1: You look carefully around the caves.
dialogue.tunnel_1_enemies_2: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_basement: You backtrack through the cave and pass through the old door to the basement.
dialogue.tunnel_1_continue: You search and find a way deeper into the tunnels.
dialogue.tunnel_1_continue_choice: Are you sure you want to continue?
dialogue.option.tunnel_1_continue_2: Yes, delve further down the tunnels
dialogue.tunnel_1_continue_check: You approach the precipice and look down.
dialogue.tunnel_1_rope_missing: There is a sharp drop with no way to climb down.
dialogue.tunnel_1_rope_missing_2: 'I should look for a Rope to climb down.'
dialogue.tunnel_1_place_rope: You secure the rope and drop it down the ledge.
dialogue.enter_tunnel_2: You climb down the rope and delve deeper into the tunnels.
dialogue.tunnel_2_intro: You notice the tunnel walls widen as you descend.
dialogue.tunnel_2_cont: Along the walls of the cavern you see markings painted in red.
dialogue.tunnel_2_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.option.tunnel_2_return: Return to the upper level of the tunnels
dialogue.tunnel_2_explore_1: You look through the cavern for hidden items.
dialogue.tunnel_2_explore_2: You are certain that you found everything in the cavern.
dialogue.tunnel_2_enemies_1: You look carefully around the cavern.
dialogue.tunnel_2_enemies_2: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_tunnel_1: You backtrack through the cavern and climb up the rope to the upper tunnels.
dialogue.tunnel_2_continue: Among the crevices of the cavern walls, you find an iron door.
dialogue.tunnel_2_continue_choice: Are you sure you want to enter?
dialogue.tunnel_2_continue_check: You approach the iron door and inspect its handle.
dialogue.tunnel_2_sewer_locked_2: 'I might be able to find a spare key somewhere here.'
dialogue.tunnel_2_unlock_sewer: You place the key into the slot and hear a faint click.
dialogue.enter_sewer: You open the door and pass into a stone hallway.
dialogue.sewer_intro: The cold damp air surrounds you with an unpleasant odor.
dialogue.sewer_cont: 'This must be the sewer system under the town.'
dialogue.sewer_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.sewer_explore_1: You look through the sewer for hidden items.
dialogue.sewer_enemies_1: You set forth to find enemies in the sewers.
dialogue.sewer_enemies_2: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_tunnel_2: You pass through the sewer door and return to the hidden tunnels.
dialogue.sewer_continue: Exploring the sewers, you find a reinforced steel door.
dialogue.sewer_continue_check: You grab the handle and push down...
dialogue.sewer_dungeon_locked_2: 'I might be able to find a spare key somewhere here.'
dialogue.sewer_unlock_dungeon: You place the key into the slot and hear a faint click.
dialogue.enter_dungeon: You pass through the door into a long, dark hallway.
dialogue.dungeon_intro: You hear the sound of shouting as you climb up the long stairway.
dialogue.dungeon_cont: 'I see, this is the town dungeon. It looks like the prisoners have escaped.'
dialogue.dungeon_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.dungeon_explore_1: You look through the dungeon for hidden items.
dialogue.dungeon_enemies_1: You set forth to find enemies in the dungeon.
dialogue.dungeon_enemies_2: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_sewer: You pass through the dungeon door and return to the sewers.
dialogue.dungeon_continue: In the far corner of the dungeon, you find a stone door.
dialogue.dungeon_continue_check: You attempt to open the door...
dialogue.dungeon_town_locked_2: 'There might be a key somewhere here.'
dialogue.dungeon_unlock_town: You insert and twist the key.
dialogue.enter_town: You exit the dungeon and emerge outside the keep.
dialogue.town_intro: Hearing fighting, you rush towards town to help.
dialogue.town_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.town_vendors_choice: Whom would you like to visit?
dialogue.town_black_market_choice: Who would you like to visit?
dialogue.town_fence_1: New customer, eh? Welcome to my market.
dialogue.town_fence_2: I'm interested in buying just about anything. Even if its previous owner has been... displaced.
dialogue.town_fence_3: Would you like to make a deal?
dialogue.town_fence_return: Back again? Looking to make a deal?
dialogue.town_fence_choice: Exchange your extra items for gold?
dialogue.town_fence_no_response: Suit yourself. I'll be here when you find something worth selling.
dialogue.town_fence_yes: Excellent. Let's see what you've brought me.
dialogue.town_fence_nothing: You call this merchandise? Come back when you've found something worth my time.
dialogue.town_witch_intro_1: Hello, my dear. Would you be interested in potions?
dialogue.town_witch_intro_2: I can combine herbs to increase your power.
dialogue.town_witch_explain_1: Rare Potion: one Rare Ingredient, five Cave Mushrooms, and 1,000 coins. It increases your power by three.
dialogue.town_witch_explain_2: Strange Potion: one Strange Herb, five Cave Mushrooms, and 100 coins. It increases your power by one.
dialogue.town_witch_explain_3: Bring me twenty-five Bones and I can draw out their lingering power.
dialogue.town_witch_rare_missing: You do not have what I need for a Rare Potion.
dialogue.town_witch_strange_missing: You do not have what I need for a Strange Potion.
dialogue.town_witch_coins_missing: Come back when you have enough coins, my dear.
dialogue.town_witch_bones_missing: Bring me twenty-five Bones and we can make an exchange.
dialogue.town_witch_rare_1: She adds the Rare Ingredient and Cave Mushrooms to her cauldron.
dialogue.town_witch_strange_1: She adds the Strange Herb and Cave Mushrooms to her cauldron.
dialogue.town_witch_blue: The liquid in the cauldron turns blue!
dialogue.town_witch_green: The liquid in the cauldron turns green!
dialogue.town_witch_bottle: She pours the liquid into a bottle and hands it to you.
dialogue.town_witch_drink: You plug your nose and drink the potion.
dialogue.town_witch_bones_1: You hand her the Bones. She carefully arranges them before her.
dialogue.town_witch_bones_2: She whispers something under her breath. The Bones begin to crumble.
dialogue.town_witch_bones_3: A strange warmth passes through your body.
dialogue.town_witch_goodbye: I hope you enjoyed. Come again soon!
dialogue.town_blacksmith_2: A new customer! I'm sorry, but the shop is closed.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_3: My assistant is nowhere to be found, and with bandits ravaging the town, I've little reason to keep the forge burning.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_4: I only wish I could have fulfilled my master's last wish.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_6: Yes. He spent much of his life trying to recover an ancient forging technique passed down through his family.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_7: His father died suddenly, before he could teach him the technique in full.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_8: His family lived in this region for generations. We searched old records, archives... Anything we could find. Nothing.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_9: 'I'm sorry to hear that. If I find anything, I'll let you know.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_10: Thank you, but don't get your hopes up.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_return_1: Ah, you've returned. What is it?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_return_2: 'I wanted to see if you'd made any progress with the technique.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_1: 'I found something you may be interested in.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_3: You reveal the Book of Forbidden Knowledge.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_4: Good heavens! What an ominous thing! Why would you bring that here?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_5: 'It's alright. I found a safe way to read it.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_6: Is that so? Well, what did you find?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_7: 'It contains an ancient technique for forging armor and weapons.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_10: You copy the relevant passages and hand them to the blacksmith.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_11: By all that is holy... this is it! This is the technique my master described!
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_12: Where in the world did you find such a book?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_13: 'It was sitting on a shelf in my house.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_14: Your house?! Why would your family possess something like this?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_15: 'I believe my great-grandfather confiscated it from people he didn't trust.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_16: Your great-grandfather must have been quite the man.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_20: Of course! I suppose that explains how such a book ended up in your family's possession.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_21: I should reward you for this. I saved some gold in the hope that someday a collector might uncover the missing technique.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_23: The blacksmith hands you a pouch of coins.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_24: And now that I have the complete instructions, I can finally put my master's teachings to use.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_25: Come back when you've found the proper materials. If you provide them, I'll forge the equipment for you.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_27: The material described here is exceptionally rare. But if you find ancient armaments, I may be able to salvage what I need from them.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_28: 'I'll let you know if I find any.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_knowledge_29: Good. Perhaps some good can still come of these dark times.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_1: Ah, you've returned. Have you found anything?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_2: 'I found this. I thought you might want to take a look.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_3: You show him an Ancient Armament.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_4: Hmm... I've never seen anything quite like this.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_6: The blacksmith retrieves the copy of the ancient forging technique and carefully compares it with the armament.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_7: Yes... this is it! This is the material described in the instructions!
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_9: I believe so. With enough of these, I should be able to forge the equipment described in the technique.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_11: I'll need four Ancient Armaments for the armor, or two for the weapon.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_12: I'll also need some gold for the work. I'll give you a fair price, considering everything you've done for me.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armament_14: Then bring me what you need, and I'll see what I can do.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_craft_return: Back again? Have you brought the materials?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_craft_choice: What would you like me to forge?
dialogue.town_blacksmith_nothing_2: Very well. Come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_gold_1: You don't have enough gold for the work.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_gold_2: 'I understand. I'll come back when I do.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_armor_1: You don't have enough Ancient Armaments. I'll need four to forge the armor.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_armor_2: 'I'll see if I can find more.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_weapon_1: You don't have enough Ancient Armaments. I'll need two to forge the weapon.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_no_weapon_2: 'I'll see if I can find another.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armor_1: 'I'd like you to forge the armor.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armor_2: Very well. Four Ancient Armaments, and the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armor_4: The blacksmith takes the Ancient Armaments and carries them to the forge.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_weapon_1: 'I'd like you to forge the weapon.'
dialogue.town_blacksmith_weapon_2: Very well. Two Ancient Armaments, and the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_weapon_4: The blacksmith takes the Ancient Armaments and carries them to the forge.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_forge_1: Give me some time. This isn't something I intend to rush.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_forge_3: For some time, the smithy rings with the sound of hammer striking ancient metal.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armor_complete_: The blacksmith emerges from the forge carrying a newly forged set of armor.
I never thought I would see my master's work completed.
Take it. You've earned the right to wear it.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_weapon_complete: The blacksmith emerges from the forge carrying an enormous greatsword.
I can hardly believe it. A weapon forged with a technique thought lost for generations.
Take it. Put it to good use.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_armor_already: The armor is already finished. I doubt I'll ever have the materials to make another set like it.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_weapon_already: The greatsword is already finished. One was difficult enough.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_complete_1: You've done it. My master's work is finally complete.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_complete_4: Take care of that equipment. There may never be another set like it.
dialogue.town_blacksmith_complete_return: Ah, Nicholas. How is the equipment serving you?
dialogue.town_inn_NYI: The inn is currently under repairs, but do please come again later!
dialogue.town_inn_bed_ready: Welcome back. Your room is just as you left it.
dialogue.town_inn_2: Welcome to my inn. Would you like to rent a room?
dialogue.town_inn_choice: Would you like to rent a room for 10 coins?
dialogue.town_inn_low_funds: I'm afraid you don't have enough coin.
dialogue.town_inn_yes: 'Yes, I'd like to rent a room. Here's the coin.'
dialogue.town_inn_yes_3: Thank you. Your room is right this way.
dialogue.town_inn_wake: You wake to the muffled sounds of the town beyond your room.
dialogue.town_specialty_2: I have an interest in unusual things. Things most merchants would not recognize.
dialogue.town_specialty_3: If you find Ancient Armaments or Crystal Fragments, bring them to me. I'll make it worth your while.
dialogue.town_specialty_none: Hmm. Nothing of interest. Come back when that changes.
dialogue.town_specialty_exchange_1: You hand over the Ancient Armaments. He examines them silently before placing his hand upon yours.
dialogue.town_specialty_exchange_2: He mutters something under his breath. For a moment, you feel a strange sensation pass through your body.
dialogue.town_specialty_exchange_3: You exchanged {count} Ancient Armament(s) for {power} increased player power.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_none: You do not have enough Crystal Fragments. Bring me ten and we can make an exchange.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_1: You show him the Crystal Fragments. His expression changes almost immediately.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_2: These still hold traces of whatever power they were exposed to. Ten should be enough.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_3: You hand over the Crystal Fragments. He gathers them in his palm and closes his hand around them.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_4: He mutters something under his breath. One by one, the fragments lose their color. For a moment, you feel a strange sensation pass through your body.
dialogue.town_specialty_crystal_5: You exchanged {count} Crystal Fragments for {power} increased player power.
dialogue.town_sewer_1: You search the town for a way back to the tunnels.
dialogue.town_sewer_2: You find an entrance to the sewers and sneak inside.
dialogue.town_3: After helping the townspeople, you set your sights on the church.
dialogue.town_4: Approaching the church, you find it sealed. You remember there is an old crypt that leads to it.
dialogue.town_5: You approach the crypt entrance and slowly walk down.
dialogue.return_to_sewer_2: You use the secret entrance to return to the sewers.
dialogue.enter_crypt_1: You pass through the door and descend the dark stairs.
dialogue.crypt_1_intro: As you reach the bottom of the stairs, you can hear chants echo in the halls.
dialogue.crypt_1_cont: Hiding behind a sarcophagus, you see hooded men perform a ritual.
dialogue.crypt_1_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.option.crypt_1_explore: Sneak around and inspect the altar
dialogue.crypt_1_explore_1: You slowly move through the crypt and approach the altar.
dialogue.crypt_1_explore_2: You step away from the accursed altar.
dialogue.crypt_1_enemies_choice: Whom would you like to fight?
dialogue.crypt_1_enemies_1: You set forth to face the undead roaming the crypts.
dialogue.crypt_1_enemies_1_cont: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.crypt_1_enemies_2: You draw your weapon and approach the ritualists.
dialogue.crypt_1_enemies_2_cont: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_town: You exit the old crypt and return to town.
dialogue.crypt_1_continue: You see stairs leading down deeper into the crypts.
dialogue.crypt_1_reconsider_1: 'I have a bad feeling about that ritual.'
dialogue.crypt_1_reconsider_2: 'Maybe I should investigate it further before going deeper...'
dialogue.enter_crypt_2: You descend the stairs and arrive at the next floor of the crypts.
dialogue.crypt_2_intro: Entering the large chamber, you see numerous sarcophagi.
dialogue.crypt_2_cont: across the room dark figures are lit by torchlight.
dialogue.crypt_2_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.option.crypt_2_return: Return to the upper level of the crypt
dialogue.crypt_2_explore_1: Searching the crypt, you find an old chest.
dialogue.crypt_2_explore_2: With the amulet in hand you ponder its significance.
dialogue.crypt_2_enemies_choice: Whom would you like to fight?
dialogue.crypt_2_enemies_1: You set forth to face the undead roaming the crypts.
dialogue.crypt_2_enemies_1_cont: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.crypt_2_enemies_2: You draw your weapon and approach the mighty undead.
dialogue.crypt_2_enemies_2_cont: With the threat dealt with, you continue onward.
dialogue.return_to_crypt_1: You walk up the stairs returning to the upper crypt.
dialogue.crypt_2_continue: You see stairs leading to the crypt's main chamber.
dialogue.crypt_2_reconsider_1: 'I don't know what may be waiting in there.'
dialogue.reaper_lord_alive: Slay him... Kill them all... and you shall be rewarded.
dialogue.reaper_lord_reward_1: Graye is dead... Your reward awaits...
dialogue.reaper_lord_reward_2: This Ring will grant you my blessing...
dialogue.reaper_ritual_1: You place the crystal back on the pedestal.
dialogue.reaper_ritual_2: You recite the summoning spell and the room darkens.
dialogue.reaper_intro_2: 'I am Nicholas, a farmer. My home is under attack and I need help.'
dialogue.reaper_intro_3: I will make you a deal. Become my champion, and I will grant you power... at a cost.
dialogue.reaper_make_choice: Will you accept, not knowing the cost?
dialogue.reaper_accept_1: Yes... the cost is simple... You must slay Lord Graye.
dialogue.reaper_accept_2: He also tried to make a deal with me, but he is of no use to me.
dialogue.reaper_accept_3: [Shadows surround you] But first, I give you my blessing...
dialogue.reaper_decline_paladin: As Paladin and heir to Master Alden, I shall never accept!
dialogue.reaper_decline_2: ...my powers are growing... I will return...
dialogue.reaper_decline_3: 'I know the ritual from the book. I can weaken him and banish him for good.'
dialogue.reaper_boss_choice: Choose the strength of the spell
dialogue.reaper_boss_victory: With the evil banished, the lights in the room return.
dialogue.reaper_boss_victory_2: An uneasy silence settles over the chamber.
dialogue.enter_crypt_3: You proceed to the deepest chamber of the crypt.
dialogue.crypt_3_intro: Entering the crypt, you see an old tomb and hear voices in the distance.
dialogue.crypt_3_cont: 'Those look like heavily armed men. I need to prepare.'
dialogue.crypt_3_choice: What would you like to do?
dialogue.crypt_3_inspect_items: You lay your belongings down on the ground to inspect.
dialogue.crypt_3_items_choice: What would you like to check?
dialogue.option.crypt_3_inspect_page: Read the page from the altar
dialogue.option.crypt_3_inspect_forbidde: Read the book of forbidden knowledge
dialogue.option.crypt_3_do_nothing: Put your things back and do nothing
dialogue.crypt_3_tome_2: The first section covers your great-grandfather's life.
dialogue.crypt_3_tome_3: The section on his training reveals secret paladin techniques.
dialogue.crypt_3_tome_4: 'If I can find his chest, I too can be a paladin.'
dialogue.crypt_3_tome_summary: This revealed that Master Alden hid a chest in your basement.
dialogue.crypt_3_page_2: Reading the page you learn of the curse on the book of forbidden knowledge.
dialogue.crypt_3_page_3: The curse can be prevented by wearing a protective amulet.
dialogue.crypt_3_page_4: The amulet's description matches the one in the crypt.
dialogue.crypt_3_page_summary: This page reveals you can read the forbidden book while wearing the amulet.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_2: You put on the amulet and open the book.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_3: Protected by the amulet, you begin deciphering the forbidden writings.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_4: The writings describe a dark being trapped within the crypt.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_5: You learn of a ritual that can summon the being—and perhaps banish it.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_6: Among the forbidden rites, you discover a lost forging technique.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_7: It describes how ancient armaments can be reforged into something far more powerful.
dialogue.crypt_3_forbidden_warning: This is the book of forbidden knowledge.
dialogue.crypt_3_tomb_1: Reading the inscription you learn this is your great grandfather's tomb.
dialogue.crypt_3_tomb_2: In the small chest near the tomb you find a shiny key.
dialogue.crypt_3_empty_room: Lord Graye is gone and the room is empty.
dialogue.crypt_3_bodies: The room is littered with the bodies of Lord Graye and his guards.
dialogue.crypt_3_conversation_1: Who are you? And what are you doing here?!
dialogue.crypt_3_conversation_2: 'I am Nicholas, my home was invaded so I fled through the tunnels and ended up here.'
dialogue.crypt_3_conversation_3: You were in the tunnels?! You were the one who ruined the ritual!
dialogue.crypt_3_conversation_4: All is lost now... Begone from my sight!
dialogue.crypt_3_combat_2: 'I am the champion of the reaper Sa, and I have come for your head.'
dialogue.crypt_3_lord_encounter: You defeated the lord and his men.
dialogue.crypt_3_combat_final: Their bodies litter the ground as laughter echoes through the room.
dialogue.return_to_crypt_2: You go back to the main crypt chamber.
dialogue.inspect_basement_chest: In the corner of the room there is something covered in a cloth.
dialogue.basement_chest_1: Pulling back the cloth an old chest is revealed.
dialogue.basement_chest_2: Unfortunately, the chest is locked tight. Why is it here?
dialogue.paladin_chest_1: Unveiling the chest, you realize it must be your great-grandfather's.
dialogue.paladin_chest_locked: Noticing it's locked, you wonder if there is a key back in the crypt.
dialogue.paladin_chest_2: Using the shiny key, you slowly open the chest.
dialogue.paladin_chest_3: The chest is filled with relics: old armor, a warhammer, and a paladin's sigil.
dialogue.paladin_chest_4: 'The tome described the paladin initiation ritual in detail.'
dialogue.paladin_chest_5: 'I must find an altar. I remember there being one in the crypt below the church.'
dialogue.paladin_chest_reaper: I have no use for a paladin's relics.
dialogue.crypt_3_altar_scene: You approach the altar and kneel.
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_choice: Will you bind yourself to the sigil and become a paladin?
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_decline: 'I am not sure that I am worthy of such an honor...'
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_1: 'I am the great-grandson of Master Alden. I am a paladin by birthright!'
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_2: You grasp the sigil in your hands, and close your eyes.
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_3: You recite the oath, each word resonating deep within you.
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_4: As you finish reciting, you feel a warm light surround you.
dialogue.crypt_3_paladin_6: 'With the power of the Light, I will protect my family!'
dialogue.farm_saved_1: You rush over to the grain storage shed and knock on the door.
dialogue.farm_saved_2: 'It is I, Nicholas! The bandits are no longer a threat!'
dialogue.farm_saved_3: You a noise as the door opens.
dialogue.farm_saved_4: You have reunited with your family!
dialogue.good_ending_1: You hug them and explain your ordeals.
exploration.search_victory: You defeat your attackers and may now claim your spoils
exploration.search_success: You retrieve the items without drawing attention.
exploration.door_encounter: You evade multiple attacks and draw your weapon.
exploration.door_boss: Captain Hravna draws his axe and charges at you.
exploration.tunnel_1_encounter: A hooded figure wielding daggers stands before you.
exploration.tunnel_1_enemies: You find giant rats swarming the caves.
exploration.tunnel_2_enemies: The cavern is filled with goblins.
exploration.sewer_enemies: You see a group of bandits have made a camp in the sewers.
exploration.dungeon_enemies: The dungeon is swarming with invading bandits.
exploration.crypt_1_enemies_1: The first level of the crypt echoes with the sound of footsteps.
exploration.crypt_1_enemies_2: You hear more footsteps within the crypt.
exploration.crypt_2_enemies_1: The depths of the crypt roar with the sound of the undead.
exploration.crypt_2_enemies_2: More undead can be heard as you delve deeper into the crypt.
exploration.crypt_3_graye_encounter: Lord Graye and his remaining guards approach you.
exploration.reaper_boss_1: A dark shadow rises from the ground and appears before you.
exploration.reaper_boss_2: A dark shadow rises from the ground and appears before you.
exploration.reaper_boss_3: A dark shadow rises from the ground and appears before you.
exploration.reaper_boss_4: A dark shadow rises from the ground and appears before you.
exploration.tunnel_1_rope_1: You find a rope in the chest so you take it and tie it to your belt.
exploration.altar_1: The altar is covered in blood and has some strange objects sitting on it.
exploration.chest_2: You find an old chest with an eye marking.
exploration.crate_1: Before you stands a large crate.
exploration.small_chest: This ornate chest has the name 'Master Alden' inscribed on it.
